title: Does anyone else sees elevator bathrooms in shared/recurring dreams
content: One thing I have seen rather often on these type of dreams is some sort of elevator bathrooms in some buildings. And in those dreams they're usually quietly agreed upon as a normal thing that exists, these elevator bathrooms are basically around 50% bigger than a normal elevator and are usually covered in normal bathroom tiles, have a toilet and sink but normal elevator doors and buttons.(Yes they do move up and down) Also many but not all of them have cameras. As the title says I'd like to know if anyone else also sees them in dreams or if it was entirely made up by my subconscious alone.
